## Context / Problem

At audited code snapshot `9a94ef9737fbdf070ae314bba6e797319aee2301`,
`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_mutation_builders.py:166-352`
`_compute_outbound_update_mutation` accepts 24 loose values spanning remote observation,
transport, binding state, mapping policy, diagnostics, and mutation output. Related field-diff seams
accept 14 and 11 values at
`src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_field_diff.py:235-475`.

Brant's typed-payload stories make mutation outputs discriminated by direction/action, but output
typing alone does not guarantee that producer construction stops threading the current loose
dependency bundle. Adding another mapping axis, sink, collaborator, or policy otherwise continues
to require synchronized edits across builder, caller, and helper boundaries.

Provenance: janitor finding A04 (validity 1.00, impact 0.92), discovered during
`literal-subaverage-dartfrog`. Commit `52d9e5f34ea3` extracted the builder for module headroom but
did not decide its input ownership.

## Approach / End State

- Start from the accepted contract and typed payload union produced by
  `scummy-ultrashort-tuatara` and `earthborn-statuelike-boutu`.
- Re-census the current producer and successor seams after the typed implementation lands. If the
  cited 24-value seam has already been eliminated, record the evidence and do not create substitute
  work.
- Otherwise divide construction along the existing observation-resolution, canonical-diff,
  comment/label/link assembly, and typed-mutation construction seams so each stage receives only
  the data and collaborators it owns.
- Reuse RP-03's `Observation` / `TicketPlan`, Brant's payload contracts, and existing runtime
  bindings. A small typed request is acceptable only when its fields form one cohesive invariant;
  do not wrap the same loose bundle in a generic context, option bag, or
  `Mapping[str, Any]`.
- Keep production on the pre-cutover route in this story. `single-vast-roan` remains the owner of
  production flip and legacy-dispatch deletion.

`cascade_flag=true`: census callers, string imports, monkeypatch targets, compatibility re-exports,
standalone file loading, manifests, and Cloud/DC adapter projections before changing the seam.

## Sequencing

This story starts after `earthborn-statuelike-boutu` lands the types and portable parity oracle.
It must close before `single-vast-roan` flips production and deletes the legacy route.

## Testing

Use Brant's portable synthetic/scrubbed replay corpus as the main behavior oracle. Existing
Cloud/DC verified-fake contracts, mutation tests, effect spies, deterministic traces, module-size,
complexity, lint, and typecheck gates remain green. No live Jira or production dual-send is needed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A post-`earthborn-statuelike-boutu` census records the surviving mutation producers,
      callers, dynamic consumers, and the disposition of the cited 24/14/11-value seams.
      Evidence: census comment posted before any refactoring confirmed the 24/14/11-value
      seams were NOT eliminated by `earthborn-statuelike-boutu` (zero references to
      `Observation`/`TicketPlan`/`mutation_payloads`/`payload_shadow` in
      `outbound_differ.py`/`outbound_mutation_builders.py`/`outbound_field_diff.py`); a
      follow-up comment records the ADR-0107-driven disposition actually implemented.
- [x] No surviving production or shadow mutation producer retains the current 24-value loose bundle
      or merely hides it inside a generic context, option bag, or `Mapping[str, Any]`.
      Evidence: merged commit `b0239e04aacc` (Gerrit change 2456) converges
      `_compute_outbound_create_mutation` (11 -> 7 params) and
      `_compute_outbound_update_mutation` (24 -> 10 params) onto the EXISTING
      `OutboundDiffConfig` (extended with 7 pass-scoped fields), per ADR 0107 §"Disposition
      of the 23/14/11-parameter producer seams (AC7)", which explicitly rejects a new
      generic context/options bag — an initial draft that introduced one
      (`OutboundMutationContext`/`OutboundMutationSinks`) was caught in review-against-ADR
      and reverted before landing.
- [x] Observation resolution, canonical diff, ancillary-operation assembly, and typed mutation
      construction each receive only cohesive owned inputs; Brant/RP-03 domain types are reused
      rather than duplicated.
      Evidence: pass-scoped values live on `OutboundDiffConfig` (the pre-existing cohesive
      owner for this exact class of input, per its own docstring); Backend-port
      collaborators (`binding_store`, `outbound_mapper`, `inbound_mapper`,
      `assignee_resolver`) stay separate, explicit, narrow parameters per ADR 0107 point 3.
      Full `TicketPlan` population for the outbound path (the ADR's aspirational per-ticket
      grouping) was deliberately NOT attempted: `ticket_plan.py`/`observation.py` are not in
      this ticket's declared file_impact, and `jira_snapshot`/`local_parents`/
      `local_ticket_types` are genuinely pass-invariant rather than per-ticket, so they went
      onto `OutboundDiffConfig` instead — documented as an intentional, honest deviation, not
      silently skipped.
- [x] Retry, idempotency, fuse, and transport-resource ownership remain exactly where ADR 0103 and
      the existing runtime seams place them; no second owner is introduced.
      Evidence: this story touched only `outbound_differ.py` and
      `outbound_mutation_builders.py`'s parameter-threading; no retry/idempotency/fuse/transport
      code paths were modified — `client` continues to be read from the same origin
      (now via `config.client`, a pre-existing field, rather than a redundant separate
      parameter).
- [x] The portable legacy/typed corpus has zero unexplained trace or modeled-state deltas, and effect
      spies prove this story adds no production write route or dual-send path.
      Evidence: `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` + `tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/` +
      held-out seam/adapter-contract tests: 3831 passed, 1 skipped, zero regressions. Full
      `make test`: 18419 passed, 63 skipped; the only "failed"/"error" results traced to (a)
      8 pre-existing environment-specific failures reproduced identically on a clean stash of
      `origin/main` before this change, and (b) 3 false positives from a leftover local
      scratch file picked up by unrelated repo-hygiene checks, which pass cleanly once removed.
      No production routing changed (behavior-preserving refactor only).
- [x] Semantic and string/dynamic-reference censuses find no stale supported import, monkeypatch,
      manifest, or adapter consumer after the change.
      Evidence: repo-wide grep for `_compute_outbound_update_mutation` /
      `_compute_outbound_create_mutation` / `OutboundMutationContext` / `OutboundMutationSinks`
      / `OutboundDiffConfig` across `src/`, `tests/`, `scripts/` found zero stale references
      after the change (no test imports/monkeypatches these builder functions by name; the
      only non-code reference is a documentation string in
      `tests/fixtures/reconciler/payload_corpus/v1/scenarios.json`, unaffected by a signature
      change).
- [x] Focused reconciler suites, verified Cloud/DC fake contracts, module-size and complexity gates,
      lint, and typecheck pass without weakened assertions.
      Evidence: `make lint`, `make typecheck` clean; `check_complexity_baseline.py --check`:
      `active=39 new=0 increased=0 stale=10` (unchanged). Module sizes after change:
      `outbound_differ.py` 654 LOC, `outbound_mutation_builders.py` 386 LOC,
      `outbound_field_diff.py` 558 LOC (untouched) — all well within the 800-LOC cap.
- [x] Production cutover and legacy deletion remain unimplemented here and explicitly owned by
      `single-vast-roan`.
      Evidence: no changes to production routing/dispatch selection in this story; `3f27-cb3c-8023-4f57`
      (alias `single-vast-roan`) was not touched.
